people.name: Manasseh
people.line: King of Judah, son of Hezekiah.

translations.web: Yahweh spoke to Manasseh, and to his people; but they didn’t listen.
translations.bsb: And the LORD spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they did not listen.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.
translations.asv: And Jehovah spake to Manasseh, and to his people; but they gave no heed.
